settings.editor: The best way to take a log home back to clean, bright wood before it's restained.

background_image.alt: Crew media blasting a log wall

settings.editor:
Old, damaged finishes have to come off before a new one can last. Media blasting strips them away and opens up the wood so new stain penetrates and bonds.

It's messy work, so we protect your home thoroughly. Interiors stay sealed off and protected, and we clean up completely when we're done.

• Removing failed stains and finishes
  • Opening up weathered wood before restaining
  • Full protection of windows, doors and interiors
  • Followed by staining and sealing
We look at the work in person, talk through colors and products, and give you a clear written estimate with no hidden charges.
Floors, furnishings, fixtures and landscaping are covered. Surfaces are cleaned, repaired and prepped to the manufacturer's specifications.
Premium coatings applied the right way, with enough coats for our dry, high-altitude climate. When we spray, we back-brush for a proper bond.
We clean up every day, then walk the finished job with you before we call it done. Your project lead is your contact the whole way.

settings.title: “We knew that blasting the old finish would be a messy task. Your team was efficient and detail oriented in making sure the interior living space was not affected.”
